packet.headline_seed: Three killed in Mexico City World Cup celebrations
packet.description_seed: More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City on Tuesday to mark the country's win over Ecuador.

what: Three killed in Mexico City World Cup celebrations

clean_source_blocks.text: More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City following Mexico's win over Ecuador in the World Cup knockout stages A 19-year-old woman is among three people to have died from suffocation during World Cup celebrations in Mexico City on Tuesday. A 48-year-old woman and a 44-year-old man were also killed after crowds descended on Mexico City following the country's 2-0 victory over Ecuador, the capital's health authority said on Wednesday. More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City, mainly around the Angel of Independence monument in downtown, to mark the country's first World Cup knockout win since 1986, the city government said. Clara Brugada Molina, head of the city's government, expressed her "most sincere condolences" to the victims' families and pledged support in the coming days.
More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City on Tuesday to mark the country's win over Ecuador.

At least two people died during massive celebrations in Mexico City as the national team advanced to the next round at the World Cup, according to the local government. A 19-year-old woman and a 44-year-old man died of asphyxiation, according to the city's health ministry on Wednesday. Authorities have not confirmed the death of a third person, reported by local media. The celebrations came after Mexico beat Ecuador to record their first World Cup knockout win since 1986, sending the co-hosts into the round of 16. More than a million people gathered in the streets of Mexico City, mainly around the Angel of Independence monument, according to estimates by the city government.

"After performing first aid and CPR techniques on the patients, they were transferred to a hospital for specialised medical care," the city's health authority said. All three have been confirmed to have died from suffocation and identified by their families, they added. ---

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City following Mexico's win over Ecuador in the World Cup knockout stages

A 19-year-old woman is among three people to have died from suffocation during World Cup celebrations in Mexico City on Tuesday.

A 48-year-old woman and a 44-year-old man were also killed after crowds descended on Mexico City following the country's 2-0 victory over Ecuador, the capital's health authority said on Wednesday.

More than one million people took to the streets of Mexico City, mainly around the Angel of Independence monument in downtown, to mark the country's first World Cup knockout win since 1986, the city government said.

Clara Brugada Molina, head of the city's government, expressed her "most sincere condolences" to the victims' families and pledged support in the coming days.

"After performing first aid and CPR techniques on the patients, they were transferred to a hospital for specialised medical care," the city's health authority said.

All three have been confirmed to have died from suffocation and identified by their families, they added.

---

[Lähde: TRT World]
At least two people died during massive celebrations in Mexico City as the national team advanced to the next round at the World Cup, according to the local government.

A 19-year-old woman and a 44-year-old man died of asphyxiation, according to the city's health ministry on Wednesday.

Authorities have not confirmed the death of a third person, reported by local media.

The celebrations came after Mexico beat Ecuador to record their first World Cup knockout win since 1986, sending the co-hosts into the round of 16.

More than a million people gathered in the streets of Mexico City, mainly around the Angel of Independence monument, according to estimates by the city government.

payload.title: Kolme kuoli Mexico Cityn MM-juhlissa
payload.summary: Mexico Cityn viranomaisten mukaan kolme ihmistä kuoli tukehtumiseen sen jälkeen, kun yli miljoona ihmistä kokoontui juhlimaan Meksikon voittoa Ecuadorista jalkapallon MM-kisojen pudotuspeleissä.
payload.content:
Kolme ihmistä on kuollut tukehtumiseen Mexico Cityssä järjestetyissä jalkapallon MM-juhlissa, pääkaupungin terveysviranomaiset kertoivat keskiviikkona. Yli miljoona ihmistä lähti tiistaina kaduille juhlimaan Meksikon 2-0-voittoa Ecuadorista ja maan ensimmäistä MM-pudotuspelivoittoa sitten vuoden 1986.

## Yli miljoona ihmistä kaduilla

Mexico Cityn kaupunginhallituksen mukaan väkijoukot kerääntyivät erityisesti keskustassa sijaitsevan Itsenäisyyden enkelin muistomerkin ympärille. Juhlat alkoivat sen jälkeen, kun Meksiko oli varmistanut etenemisensä seuraavalle kierrokselle voittamalla Ecuadorin MM-kisojen pudotuspeleissä.

Kaupungin arvion mukaan kaduilla oli yli miljoona ihmistä. Kokoontumiset keskittyivät pääkaupungin keskeisille alueille, kun kannattajat juhlistivat maajoukkueen etenemistä 16 parhaan joukkoon. Voitto oli Meksikolle poikkeuksellinen, sillä maa ei ollut voittanut MM-kisojen pudotuspeliä sitten vuoden 1986.

## Uhrit tunnistettiin perheiden avulla

Pääkaupungin terveysviranomaisten mukaan kuolleet olivat 19-vuotias nainen, 48-vuotias nainen ja 44-vuotias mies. Viranomaiset kertoivat, että uhreille annettiin ensiapua ja elvytystä ennen kuin heidät siirrettiin sairaalaan erikoistuneeseen hoitoon.

Terveysviranomaisten mukaan kaikki kolme vahvistettiin kuolleiksi tukehtumisen seurauksena. Viranomaiset lisäsivät, että uhrien perheet olivat tunnistaneet heidät.

## Kaupunki lupasi tukea omaisille

Mexico Cityn hallituksen johtaja Clara Brugada Molina esitti osanottonsa uhrien perheille. Hän sanoi kaupungin tukevan omaisia tulevina päivinä.

Tapaus varjosti laajaa kansanjuhlaa, joka oli täyttänyt pääkaupungin kadut Meksikon voiton jälkeen. Viranomaisten antamien tietojen mukaan juhlat liittyivät maajoukkueen etenemiseen seuraavalle kierrokselle, mutta suurten väkijoukkojen keskellä kolme ihmistä menehtyi tukehtumiseen ennen kuin heidän kuolemansa vahvistettiin.
summary_bullets: Kolme ihmistä kuoli tukehtumiseen Mexico Cityn MM-juhlissa.
Yli miljoona ihmistä kokoontui juhlimaan Meksikon 2-0-voittoa Ecuadorista.
Viranomaisten mukaan uhrit saivat ensiapua ja heidät vietiin sairaalahoitoon ennen kuoleman vahvistamista.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu paketin viranomaisiin nojaaviin tietoihin; TRT:n mainitsema varaus kolmannen kuoleman vahvistamisesta huomioitiin, mutta BBC:n viranomaislausunto vahvistaa kolme kuollutta.
